answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because cedar only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, pulse is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any island approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
